race.comment: PUISSANCE PLAYBOY (1) was in great form all last campaign. He ran so many good races with only the one victory late but that has to stand him up nicely for this. Should get a sweet run all the way sitting up near the speed. I'LL KEEP HALF (5) has run well fresh up before. Can handle any sort of track and should be well suited in this class. Must be a contender. IMPORT (3) broke the maiden nicely earlier this year. He wasn't bad coming from near last in a Class 2 thereafter. The barrier can let him sit closer now. CAP CAVOUR (2) is another who can get out of his ground. However he does finish off. Does go well first up. HIGHLAND JEUNEY (6) has not done much wrong. The barrier is a bit tricky though.
